title: A Schoolhouse for All
details: 📅 Q3 · Unit 8 · Statehood, Civil War, and Reconstruction

badge.name: Field Seal 20
badge.line: Only field historians earn this one. You went where your teacher can't go, and you brought back proof.

hook.look: A field file is a job card. It tells a historian where to go and what to bring back.
hook.head: Field File 20 · A Schoolhouse for All
rows: Your teacher, still stuck inside Canvas
hook.alt: An old print of seven men in suits, three standing and four sitting
hook.cap: The first Black members of Congress, 1872. Josiah T. Walls of Florida is in the middle. Library of Congress.
hook.note: After the war, Florida's 1868 constitution started public schools open to all children. Can you build one of those first schoolhouses for me?

opti.brief: She can't leave Canvas, so you build it. Make a Reconstruction schoolhouse. Then send her one photo.
opti.desk: No headset? Use my desk. Play the game, then write 2 sentences for your teacher.

vr.look: Reconstruction (1865 to 1877) means building again after the Civil War. Florida opened public schools to all children, and many freed people went to school for the first time.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
These are the models you will use. In VR, type the gray word in the Models search box to find each one.

@MODELS@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Farm Town in Filter environments. Click Farm Town (Micro), then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the schoolhouse
steps.html: Put the 3 log walls and the door together. Put the 2 benches inside, in rows. Put the book on a bench and the lantern by the door.

steps.title: Take your photo and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Fit your whole build in the tablet. Click Take photo.

On the Canvas tab, pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 To fix it, send a new photo.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? See Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Make the room big enough for a whole class. These schools were open to all children.

vr.full: One photo that shows the walls, the door, both benches, the book and the lantern.

studio.title: Finish the Reconstruction Story
studio.look: Six sentences about Reconstruction. Each one is missing one word.
studio.do: Read the sentence. Tap the word that fits the blank.

doc.alt: The first Black members of Congress, 1872

game.miss: That word does not fit. Read the sentence again.
game.done: The story is complete! New rights came on paper, and keeping them took courage.

sentences.text: The 14th Amendment made everyone born in the United States a ___.
sentences.ok: Yes! Born here means a citizen.

sentences.text: The 15th Amendment said no one could be kept from ___ because of race.
sentences.ok: Yes! It gave Black men the right to vote.

sentences.text: In 1871, Josiah T. ___ became Florida's first Black member of Congress.
sentences.ok: Yes! He had been born enslaved.

sentences.text: Jonathan ___ led Florida's schools and worked to open them to all children.
sentences.ok: Yes! Jonathan Gibbs led the state's schools.

sentences.text: Laws called Black ___ limited what freed people could do.
sentences.ok: Yes. Black Codes took freedoms away.

frames.starter: After 1877, many rights were taken back when ...

studio.full: Your game is done, and your 2 sentences have 20 words or more.
